title: Power BI – DAX Basics Quiz
description: Short quiz on core DAX ideas. Shown on the exam card.

questions.text: Which DAX function changes the filter context of a calculation?
questions.explanation: CALCULATE evaluates an expression in a modified filter context.

questions.text: Which TWO steps reduce the size of an imported model? (Select two.)
options: Turn on Auto date/time for every table
Split date-time columns into date and time
Add a calculated column for each measure
questions.explanation: Fewer columns and lower cardinality mean better compression.

questions.text: A calculated column is recalculated every time a user changes a slicer.
questions.explanation: Calculated columns are computed at refresh time, not when filters change.

questions.text: Match each DAX function to what it does.
pairs: Evaluates an expression in a modified filter context
Returns a table with only the rows that meet a condition
Returns all rows of a table, ignoring filters
questions.explanation: Each value may be used once, more than once, or not at all.

questions.text: For each statement, select Yes if it is true. Otherwise, select No.
pairs: A star schema keeps facts and dimensions in separate tables.
A slicer change re-runs calculated columns.

questions.text: Put the steps to build and share a report in the correct order.
steps: Clean and shape the data in Power Query
